items.claim: CFO says full-year 2026 guidance is unchanged after Q1 results.
items.quote: Our full year 2026 guidance remains unchanged.
items.speaker: Alexander Bradley (CFO)

items.claim: CFO gives Q2 volume guidance of 3.4-4 GW and adjusted EBITDA of $400-500M.
items.quote: we expect volumes sold between 3.4 and 4 gigawatts
items.speaker: Alexander Bradley (CFO)

items.claim: CFO states Q1 gross margin was 47%, up ~6pp YoY on 45X tax benefit volume and lower freight costs.
items.quote: Our gross margin in the first quarter was 47%
items.speaker: Alexander Bradley (CFO)

items.claim: CFO reiterates Q2 gross margin guide is flat versus Q1, implying stronger second half.
items.quote: we're guiding to the same guide that we had in Q1
items.speaker: Alexander Bradley (CFO)

items.claim: CFO clarifies the guide assumes no tariff replacement is modeled for finished goods after Section 122 expires.
items.quote: we're not modeling tariffs beyond that for finished goods
items.speaker: Alexander Bradley (CFO)

items.claim: CEO says the Section 337 IP investigation is expected to reach an initial determination in about 11 months.
items.quote: an initial determination within approximately 11 months
items.speaker: Mark Widmar (CEO)

items.claim: CEO says headwinds against crystalline silicon competitors (trade remedy, FEOC, IP litigation) continue to build.
items.quote: headwinds for crystalline silicon continue to build
items.speaker: Mark Widmar (CEO)

items.claim: CEO describes CuRe's expected lifetime energy yield advantage over crystalline-silicon TOPCon.
items.quote: CuRe anticipated to deliver up to 8% more lifetime
items.speaker: Mark Widmar (CEO)

items.claim: CEO says successful CuRe replication across the fleet could unlock up to $0.6B of additional backlog revenue from technology adjusters, mostly in 2027-2028.
items.quote: up to $0.6 billion of additional revenue from technology
items.speaker: Mark Widmar (CEO)

items.claim: CEO reiterates the company remains well positioned to deliver on its 2026 commitments.
items.quote: we remain well positioned to deliver on our 2026 commitments
items.speaker: Mark Widmar (CEO)

items.claim: CFO says quarter-end net cash of $2B sits at the high end of the targeted resilient net cash range.
items.quote: at the high end of our targeted resilient net cash range
items.speaker: Alexander Bradley (CFO)

items.claim: CEO says customers are active in M&A/development-acquisition deals, with one option volume tied to a customer's pending acquisition.
items.quote: We're seeing a lot of M&A activity.
items.speaker: Mark Widmar (CEO)

items.claim: CEO frames the upcoming CuRe launch in India as the key enabler to manage potential ALMM efficiency-threshold revisions.
items.quote: the key enabler to make sure we manage through any
items.speaker: Mark Widmar (CEO)

qa_flags.question: Given the Section 232 decision has already slipped from year-end 2025 into Q2, what is the confidence level it lands in May or June?
qa_flags.response_pattern: Widmar did not give a firm confidence level; said 'there's still a lot of moving pieces' and that the slide reflects 'the best information we have,' without addressing why prior timelines had already slipped.
